paragraphs: Quarterhill designs, develops, and deploys technology systems for the intelligent transportation systems industry, with a presence throughout North America and Europe. Its tolling work covers toll collection, and its safety and enforcement work covers commercial vehicle enforcement, freight compliance, and active transportation management. Multi modal solutions cover container tracking and port planning, border crossings, and axle-load and track monitoring on rail lines and highway corridors.

Rail products built on Sensor Line fiber optic sensors cover speed measurement, weigh in motion, flat wheel detection, track bed analysis, axle and wagon counting, and vibration analysis. These sensors are used for predictive maintenance and for detecting changes to track and rolling stock.

Customers named on the site include government agencies, toll operators, and private sectors, along with Departments of Transportation, logistics providers, local governments, and law enforcement agencies. Enforcement agencies use the commercial vehicle inspection technologies in over 2000 lanes worldwide to prevent weigh station congestion. The company handles over 2 billion toll transactions each year for toll authorities in the United States.
